ValidationRule.description: Restrict Creating Pend Task when the Date Case on Hold from is null
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'IDR_Task', ISPICKVAL(Type,'Pend Case'), ISNEW(), OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Status,'Escalated')), ISBLANK(Date_Case_on_Hold_From__c), Date_Case_on_Hold_From__c > TODAY()), OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Status,'Re-Opened')), ISBLANK(Date_Case_on_Hold_From__c), Date_Case_on_Hold_From__c > TODAY()) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please ensure the On Hold Date field is filled and not set to a future date, or ensure the Case Status is either "Escalated" or "Re-opened" to create a Pend Task.
